```yaml
name: Coffee Bot Lottery Poster

on:
  schedule:
    - cron: '0 9 * * *' # Runs at 09:00 UTC which is 01:00 Beijing time

jobs:
  coffee-bot:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v3

      - name: Set up Java
        uses: actions/setup-java@v4
        with:
          java-version: '11'
          distribution: 'adopt'

      - name: Add MCP create_post access for bot workflows
        run: |
          echo "MCP_CREATE_POST=true" >> $GITHUB_ENV

      - name: Post daily coffee lottery thread
        run: |
          # Replace this with the actual command to post the coffee lottery thread
          echo "Posting daily coffee lottery thread..."
```

This workflow will run every day at 09:00 Beijing time and execute the command to post the daily coffee lottery thread. You need to replace the placeholder command with the actual command to post the coffee lottery thread.
